naslov: Bucks take on the Pacers on 3-game slide
tekst:
Indiana Pacers (2-1, sixth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Milwaukee Bucks (0-3, 14th in the Eastern Conference)
              Milwaukee; Monday, 8 p.m. EDT
              LINE: Pacers -4.5; over/under is 239.5
              BOTTOM LINE: Milwaukee heads into the matchup against Indiana as losers of three in a row.
              Milwaukee finished 32-50 overall and 21-31 in Eastern Conference play a season ago. The Bucks averaged 15.6 points off of turnovers, 11.7 second-chance points and 37.9 bench points last season.
              Indiana finished 19-63 overall and 15-37 in Eastern Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Pacers averaged 27.7 assists per game on 40.8 made field goals last season.
              INJURIES: Bucks: None listed.
              Pacers: Ben Sheppard: out (meniscus), Johnny Furphy: out for season (acl), T.J. McConnell: out (hamstring).
